loops.description: Single-pass refinement loop: sync main -> pick one issue -> write one grounded user story -> mark done

tasks.name: Preflight: require a clean tree and sync main
commandArgs: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && git switch main && git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

tasks.name: Select and reserve the oldest refine:pick issue
commandArgs: issue=$(gh issue list --label "refine:pick" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,title,body --jq "sort_by(.number) | .[0] // empty | {number,title,body}"); test -n "$issue" || exit 75; number=$(printf "%s" "$issue" | jq -r .number); gh issue edit "$number" --add-label refine:doing --remove-label refine:pick >/dev/null; printf "%s\n" "$issue"

tasks.name: AI: write one grounded user story without clarification questions
commandArgs: Rewrite GitHub issue {{number}} as a single autonomous refinement pass. Before editing, read and follow the repository-local skill at ai/.agents/skills/user-story/SKILL.md to structure the issue as a development-ready user story, then read and apply ai/.agents/skills/humanizer/SKILL.md to the final prose. The feature to capture is: {{title}}. Context from the issue body: {{body}}. Ground the story in the actual codebase by reading relevant files. Update the GitHub issue body yourself with the final user story in Mike Cohn As a/I want to/so that format, Gherkin Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, edge cases, and a Mermaid diagram if appropriate. Make reasonable assumptions from the issue and codebase; do not ask clarification questions, append questions, or create a question branch. Always apply the 'refine:done' label, remove 'refine:doing', and keep the final body as valid Markdown. Do not ask me anything during the session.

tasks.name: Verify: the single refinement is marked refine:done
commandArgs: labels=$(gh issue view {{number}} --json labels --jq '.labels[].name'); echo "$labels" | grep -qE '^refine:done$' && exit 0 || exit 1

tasks.name: Recovery: return an incomplete refinement to refine:pick
Idle: no refine:pick issues are available
commandArgs: Nothing to refine, no issues with refine:pick label
